title: cephalaria scabra
intro: Cephalaria scabra, commonly known as hairy pincushion flower or rough cephalaria, is a flowering plant species in the family Caprifoliaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Eastern Europe and Asia, due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria scabra are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exert anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory infections, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
